source_title: Urhobo to English Dictionary (Ebireri Okrokoto 2020, Urhobo Language Institute)

notation_system.description: Okrokoto explicitly defines four tone categories in his front-matter (page 1) using pedagogical shorthand 'd, r, m, ~'.

grave.description: Has a short stroke pointing left.

acute.description: Has a short stroke pointing right.

tilde.meaning: Slur / prolonged drawn vocal sound (often in negation or elision)
tilde.description: Drawing the voice on the sound of the vowel represented by a wave-like mark.
